callText: Elderly female, confused since this morning

caller.voice: Her son, worried, in casual Singapore English. He knows only what he has seen: his mother is 79 and has been confused since this morning, asking the same questions again and not knowing where she is. She did not fall and did not hit her head. She has high BP and takes her medicine.

answers.whatHappened: My mother, 79 already. This morning I found her very confused. She keep asking the same thing, don't know where she is. She never fall, never hit her head. She got high BP, she take her medicine.
answers.conscious: Conscious, she can talk, but very confused.
answers.icAndMeds: OK, I get her IC and her BP medicine ready for you.

patient.name: Siti binte Hassan
patient.voice: Speaks in full sentences, slowly, but loses track of where she is and repeats questions.
patient.chiefComplaint: Nothing bothering me... Where is this ah? Why so many people here?

lines.feelingNow: I'm OK. Why so many people here ah? Where is this?
lines.hitHead: No, I never hit my head.
lines.lungHistory: No asthma, no lung problem. Only high blood pressure.
lines.verbal: Siti binte Hassan. I'm at the market now, right?
lines.motor: OK, both arms up, like this.
lines.position: I sit here on the bed, OK.
lines.bpScreen: No shunt, no fistula. Never had operation.
lines.ic: My IC... in my pocket, here.

hazards: BP medicine box on the bedside table beside the patient

loc.response: Yes, I can hear you... who are you ah?

spine.dtbl: No deformities, tenderness, bruises or lacerations

circulation.pulse: Radial pulse present, fast and strong

investigation.auscultation: Air entry equal, breath sounds clear
